artworks.title: The Seven Chiefs against Thebes
artworks.description: Mongez's Seven Chiefs — seven Argive champions arrayed for the assault on Cadmus' gates.

artworks.title: The Oath of the Seven Chiefs against Thebes
artworks.description: Girodet's oath of the Seven — the sealed pact that binds Adrastus' army to Polynices' claim.

artworks.title: Eteocles and Polynices
artworks.description: Francken's fratricide: Eteocles and Polynices locked at the seventh gate — Aeschylus' and Statius' civil war in paint.

artworks.title: Duel of Eteocles and Polynices (Etruscan cinerary urn)
artworks.description: An Etruscan cinerary urn freezes the brothers' duel — the Seven's climax carried into Italic funerary art.

artworks.title: Tydeus, Hippomedon and Parthenopaeus (engraving of the Seven against Thebes)
artworks.description: Tydeus among the Seven — the Calydonian champion whose rage at Thebes became proverbial.

popCulture.title: Seven Against Thebes
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus' surviving Theban play — seven gates, seven champions, and the fratricide of Eteocles and Polynices.

popCulture.title: Theban Cycle
popCulture.description: The Argive assault on Cadmus' city remains the epic hinge between Oedipus' curse and Antigone's burial.
